summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload unrelated to advertised purpose
details: Version 0.0.5 of @servicetitan/anvil2-ext-mwv adds a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a shipped 727 KB obfuscated sibling file `math_init.js` (Bun-compiled bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, using a rotating string-array `WV8StW` + large constant pool typical of obfuscator.io-packed loaders). `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNNNN` identifiers and per-call string dictionaries. The package's advertised purpose is a React component library; pulling an alternate JS runtime and executing an obfuscated payload with it is unrelated to that purpose and executes attacker-controlled code on every `npm install` under a runtime that evades Node-based inspection. The CHANGELOG documents only versions 0.0.1-0.0.4 with TypeScript/React changes and does not mention Bun, math_init.js, or a preinstall hook — the dropper appears to have been inserted into an otherwise legitimate @servicetitan-scoped package, consistent with a scope hijack or maintainer-account compromise.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
